name: Lowres Labs studio motion
summary: Our pieces are stickers: light and springy. They pop, hold the pose for a beat, and settle with a bounce. Wow, wait, decrease.

framesUse.tick: contacts: an anticipation, a squash, a press
framesUse.quick: the wow, flashes, the S and M holds, a flip
framesUse.snappy: exits, fades, falls, the M hold
framesUse.settle: decreases and wobbles after a hit
framesUse.slow: counts, flights, swells, the L decrease
framesUse.beat: the pause between beats of a sequence

out.use: moves into place, the wow, counts

in.use: falls, exits, the approach to an impact

glide.use: holds, loops, idle drift, scene transitions

pop.use: arrivals with one overshoot, small decreases

wobble.use: the decrease after a wow, a landing, a slam

linear.use: spins, scrolling reels, the middle of a long count

easeNotes.bezier: cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2) for CSS, Figma, Rive, Lottie and Spine. out, in and pop are exact; glide is within 0.03%.
easeNotes.ae: After Effects keyframe velocity: influence in %, speed as a multiple of the average speed between the two keys.
easeNotes.keys: No bezier can wobble. Key it: [time, value] as fractions of the step, each key eased in and out.

staggerUse.burst: coins or values leaving one place

units.scale: multiplier of the rest scale; sx and sy multiply it
units.x: widths of the piece, from its rest position
units.y: heights of the piece, from its rest position, down is positive
units.rx: degrees around the horizontal axis (a cube turning)
units.flash: 0 to 1, the white flash layer over the art
units.pivot: where the move layer turns, as fractions of the size from the centre: [0.5, 0.5] is the bottom-right corner
units.path: fly: spread, lift and bend of the arc, in sizes of the flying piece

rig.root: Owned by layout: the SmartContainer pin. Never animated.
rig.move: x, y, angle, alpha, rx. Turns around its centre, or around a corner for a roll.
rig.body: scale, sx, sy. Scales from its centre, or from its feet when the primitive squashes.
rig.art: The sprite, centred. An optional white flash layer sits above it. Never animated.

turbo: Steps marked scaled take frames x speed (1, 0.4 or 0.12). Every other step keeps its frames.

appear.use: Utility entrances: panels, cards, prompts, the win box.
appear.avoid: Hero moments: use popIn, land or slam.

popIn.use: The signature entrance: a coin or symbol arriving, a value appearing, a title card.
popIn.avoid: Panels and other utility UI: use appear.

land.use: A piece dropping into place: a coin onto the reels, a token onto a meter.
land.avoid: Pieces that do not sit on anything.

slam.use: Something big hits the screen: a tier title, FEATURE!, a jackpot word.
slam.avoid: More than one at a time, or anything smaller than a title.

exit.use: Anything leaving: the win box, a banner, a card.
exit.avoid: Pieces that leave by moving somewhere: fly them.

wow.use: Something good just happened to this piece. S: a counter, a small value, a button. M: a symbol, a coin, a printed value. L: a title, word art, the hero of a screen.
wow.avoid: Two at once on one screen, unless they are one group doing it together.

pulse.use: Waiting for the player: PRESS TO CONTINUE, a feature that can be bought.
pulse.avoid: Anything that is not waiting for input.

float.use: Pieces at rest that carry the scene: the logo, the hero of an intro card.
float.avoid: Anything the player reads or taps, and anything on the reels.

tease.use: A piece that could trigger something: one scatter away.
tease.avoid: Pieces that cannot change the outcome.

shake.use: No: a locked button, a bet that is too high, a pick that is not allowed.

hop.use: A piece celebrating on the spot: a sticker without a frame, a collector, a pick.
hop.avoid: Framed symbols: their frame stays still, use wow on the icon.

roll.use: A cube or a tile moving one cell: it tips over its edge, balances, and falls flat.
roll.avoid: Art that is not the same after a quarter turn: it would jump when the turn resets.

tumble.use: A cube or a die dropping in: it falls, bounces twice and lands flat.
tumble.avoid: Art that is not the same after a quarter turn.

turn.use: A cube turning to its next face: a multiplier, a meter or a value that changes in place.
turn.avoid: Changes the player should not notice.

swap.use: One piece becoming another: an upgrade, a mystery reveal, a symbol transforming.
swap.avoid: Pieces that change without a reason the player can see.

flip.use: A face-down piece showing its value: a card, a coin, a pick.

fly.use: Values or coins collecting into a counter or a meter.
fly.avoid: More than about 12 pieces at once: group them.

count.use: Any amount that grows: the win box, a total, a meter.
count.avoid: Counting down, or counting what the player did not win.

cascade.use: A group arriving: a row of picks, a set of coins, menu items.
cascade.avoid: Groups of more than about 15: they take too long, group them into rows.

rules: Every emphasis is a wow: anticipate, wow, wait, decrease. Never a plain up-and-back pulse.
Durations come from the frame scale (5, 8, 13, 21, 34, 55, 89 frames at 60 fps). Never invent one.
Eases come from the six by intent: out, in, glide, pop, wobble, linear. Never the default or a custom curve.
Arrivals overshoot. Exits never do, and take at most 60% of the arrival.
Impacts squash and launches stretch, keeping the area: sx times sy stays within 0.9 to 1.1.
Moves and holds follow the turbo clock. Contacts and accents keep their frames.
One hero at a time: while an L plays nothing else starts an M or an L. Groups stagger 2 to 6 frames.
Animate the rig: move and body. Never the pinned root, never the art.
Rest is still. Idle motion only on pieces that carry the scene, at most 4% of their size, on 144 and 233 frame cycles.
Everything can skip to its end: progress(1) leaves the rest pose, never a piece half-way.
Every contact has a sound on its frame: an impact, the pop of a wow, a slam, a swap.
No flashing faster than 3 times a second, and no full-screen white flash.
Transforms and alpha only. A filter runs only while its effect plays.
A new primitive on a piece replaces the one playing and starts from where the piece is.
rules_ru: Акцент всегда делаем через wow: anticipate, wow, wait, decrease. Простой пульс туда и обратно не годится.
Длительности берём со шкалы кадров (5, 8, 13, 21, 34, 55, 89 кадров при 60 fps). Свои не придумываем.
Кривую выбираем из шести по смыслу: out, in, glide, pop, wobble, linear. Ни кривой по умолчанию, ни самодельной.
Появление с перелётом. Уход без перелёта и не дольше 60% появления.
Удар сплющивает, отрыв вытягивает, площадь сохраняется: sx × sy держится в пределах от 0.9 до 1.1.
Движения и паузы идут по часам turbo. Контакты и акценты держат свои кадры.
Один герой за раз: пока играет L, никто другой не начинает ни M, ни L. Группы идут лесенкой с шагом от 2 до 6 кадров.
Анимируем rig: слои move и body. Не трогаем ни закреплённый root, ни арт.
В покое ничего не двигается. Idle-движение только у элементов, на которых держится сцена: не больше 4% их размера, на циклах в 144 и 233 кадра.
Любую анимацию можно промотать в конец: progress(1) оставляет элемент в позе покоя, а не на полпути.
Каждый контакт звучит ровно в своём кадре: удар, pop у wow, slam, swap.
Никаких вспышек чаще 3 раз в секунду и никакой белой вспышки на весь экран.
Только трансформации и alpha. Фильтр включаем только на время его эффекта.
Новый примитив на элементе заменяет текущий и стартует оттуда, где элемент сейчас.
